name: Akhil Bharatiya Civil Services Pratiyogita
benefit: There is a provision to provide travel allowance, accommodation allowance, food allowance, sports kits, and other necessary support to all players and team members participating in the 'Akhil Bharatiya Civil Services Pratiyogita', in accordance with departmental standards.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be an employee of a government department in Uttarakhand.
